title: ScenarioForge Vulnerability Capability Metadata
description: Declares what exploiting a catalog vulnerability requires and what it yields, in the fact vocabulary used by flag generators. Consumed by flag sequencing so chains are only built when every step is reachable.

catalog.description: Optional label of the catalog these entries describe.

factRef.description: A fact signature such as CodeExecution(host). Must exist in schemas/facts/fact_ontology_reference.yaml.

match.description: Catalog entry name or rel_dir. Glob patterns (* ? [..]) are allowed. Matching is case-insensitive and also tries path suffixes.

cve.description: CVE id. Used as a fallback match when 'match' does not resolve.

impact.description: Shorthand that expands to a default set of provided facts.

requires.description: Facts that must already hold before this vulnerability is exploitable. Unioned with the impact default.

provides.description: Facts a solver gains by exploiting this vulnerability. Unioned with the impact default.
